```{r prepare-plot-data}
rt_bounds <- c(300, 3000)

parse_resp_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]", "", as.character(x))))
}

flag_to_bool <- function(x) {
  if (is.logical(x)) return(x)
  
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    return(ifelse(is.na(x), NA, x != 0))
  }
  
  str <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  str <- gsub("\\[|\\]", "", str)
  
  ifelse(
    str %in% c("1", "true", "t", "yes", "y"),
    TRUE,
    ifelse(
      str %in% c("0", "false", "f", "no", "n", ""),
      FALSE,
      NA
    )
  )
}

# Circular stats for directional or axial data
# theta_rad should be in radians on the original scale
# axial = FALSE for full-circle directional data
# axial = TRUE  for 180-degree periodic axial data
circ_stats_safe <- function(theta_rad, axial = FALSE) {
  theta_rad <- theta_rad[!is.na(theta_rad)]
  n <- length(theta_rad)

  if (n == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        R = NA_real_,
        std_circ = NA_real_,
        std_circ_deg = NA_real_,
        variance = NA_real_,
        SEr = NA_real_,
        SEs = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  theta_work <- if (axial) 2 * theta_rad else theta_rad

  C <- sum(cos(theta_work))
  S <- sum(sin(theta_work))
  R_raw <- sqrt(C^2 + S^2) / n

  if (!is.finite(R_raw)) {
    R_raw <- NA_real_
  }

  R_clamped <- if (is.na(R_raw)) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    min(max(R_raw, .Machine$double.eps), 1)
  }

  std_work <- if (is.na(R_clamped)) NA_real_ else sqrt(-2 * log(R_clamped))

  SEr <- if (is.na(R_raw)) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    sqrt(max(0, 1 - R_raw^2)) / sqrt(n)
  }

  SEs_work <- if (is.na(R_clamped) || R_clamped <= 0) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    (1 / (R_clamped * sqrt(-2 * log(R_clamped)))) * SEr
  }

  divisor <- if (axial) 2 else 1

  std_circ <- if (is.na(std_work)) NA_real_ else std_work / divisor
  std_circ_deg <- if (is.na(std_circ)) NA_real_ else std_circ * (180 / pi)
  variance <- if (is.na(R_raw)) NA_real_ else 1 - R_raw
  SEs <- if (is.na(SEs_work)) NA_real_ else SEs_work / divisor

  tibble::tibble(
    R = R_raw,
    std_circ = std_circ,
    std_circ_deg = std_circ_deg,
    variance = variance,
    SEr = SEr,
    SEs = SEs
  )
}

prepare_subset_for_plots <- function(data, subset_type, rt_bounds) {

  if (!subset_type %in% c("sub1", "sub2", "sub3")) {
    stop("subset_type must be 'sub1', 'sub2', or 'sub3'")
  }

  group_vars <- c("participant_id", "num_items", "cue_type", "duration_ms")
  axial <- subset_type == "sub3"

  mutated <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rt_ms = parse_resp_num(response_RT_from_start),
      precision_deg = parse_resp_num(response_error_deg),
      abs_precision_deg = abs(precision_deg),
      theta_rad = precision_deg * (pi / 180),
      too_fast_flag = flag_to_bool(too_fast_trigger),
      too_slow_flag = flag_to_bool(too_slow_trigger)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      fail_missing_pid = is.na(participant_id),
      fail_too_fast = too_fast_flag,
      fail_too_slow = too_slow_flag,
      fail_missing_rt = is.na(rt_ms),
      fail_rt_below = !is.na(rt_ms) & rt_ms < rt_bounds[1],
      fail_rt_above = !is.na(rt_ms) & rt_ms > rt_bounds[2],
      fail_missing_precision = is.na(precision_deg),
      retain_row = !fail_missing_pid &
                   !fail_too_fast &
                   !fail_too_slow &
                   !fail_missing_rt &
                   !fail_rt_below &
                   !fail_rt_above &
                   !fail_missing_precision
    )

  filtered <- mutated %>%
    dplyr::filter(retain_row)

  filtered_trials <- mutated %>%
    dplyr::group_by(participant_id) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      subset = subset_type,
      n_trials_before = dplyr::n(),
      n_missing_pid_rows = sum(fail_missing_pid, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_fast = sum(fail_too_fast, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_slow = sum(fail_too_slow, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_rt = sum(fail_missing_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_below = sum(fail_rt_below, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_above = sum(fail_rt_above, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_precision = sum(fail_missing_precision, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trials_after = sum(retain_row, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_filtered_total = n_trials_before - n_trials_after,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      subset,
      participant_id,
      n_trials_before,
      n_trials_after,
      n_filtered_total,
      n_too_fast,
      n_too_slow,
      n_rt_below,
      n_rt_above,
      n_missing_rt,
      n_missing_precision,
      n_missing_pid_rows
    )

  condition_stats <- filtered %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      circ = list(circ_stats_safe(theta_rad, axial = axial)),
      mean_rt = mean(rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_rt = median(rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      abs_mean = mean(abs_precision_deg, na.rm = TRUE),
      trials = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(circ)

  prepared_data <- filtered %>%
    dplyr::left_join(condition_stats, by = group_vars)

  list(
    prepared_data = prepared_data,
    filtered_trials = filtered_trials
  )
}

print_filtered_trials_summary <- function(filtered_trials_df) {
  summary_df <- filtered_trials_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(subset) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      participants = dplyr::n_distinct(participant_id, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trials_before = sum(n_trials_before, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_trials_after = sum(n_trials_after, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_filtered_total = sum(n_filtered_total, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_fast = sum(n_too_fast, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_too_slow = sum(n_too_slow, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_below = sum(n_rt_below, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_rt_above = sum(n_rt_above, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_rt = sum(n_missing_rt, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_precision = sum(n_missing_precision, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_missing_pid_rows = sum(n_missing_pid_rows, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  print(summary_df)
}

sub1_result <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub1raw, "sub1", rt_bounds)
sub2_result <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub2raw, "sub2", rt_bounds)
sub3_result <- prepare_subset_for_plots(sub3raw, "sub3", rt_bounds)

sub1prepared <- sub1_result$prepared_data
sub2prepared <- sub2_result$prepared_data
sub3prepared <- sub3_result$prepared_data

filtered_trials <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  sub1_result$filtered_trials,
  sub2_result$filtered_trials,
  sub3_result$filtered_trials
)

print_filtered_trials_summary(filtered_trials)

attr(sub1prepared, "subset_key") <- "sub1"
attr(sub2prepared, "subset_key") <- "sub2"
attr(sub3prepared, "subset_key") <- "sub3"
```


```{r plot-limits, include=FALSE}
bin_hist_max <- function(values, breaks) {
  values <- values[!is.na(values)]
  if (length(values) == 0) return(0)
  h <- hist(values, breaks = breaks, plot = FALSE)
  if (length(h$counts) == 0) return(0)
  max(h$counts, na.rm = TRUE)
}

max_bin_per_subset <- function(data, field, breaks) {
  counts <- data %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    summarise(max_bin = bin_hist_max(.data[[field]], breaks), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pull(max_bin)
  if (length(counts) == 0) return(0)
  max(counts, na.rm = TRUE)
}

precision_breaks <- seq(0, 180, by = 5)
precision_xlim <- c(0, 180)
precision_ylim_map <- list(
  sub1 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub1prepared, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub2 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub2prepared, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub3 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub3prepared, "abs_precision_deg", precision_breaks), na.rm = TRUE))
)

rt_breaks <- seq(rt_bounds[1], rt_bounds[2], by = 50)
rt_xlim <- rt_bounds
rt_ylim_map <- list(
  sub1 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub1prepared, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub2 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub2prepared, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE)),
  sub3 = c(0, max(1, max_bin_per_subset(sub3prepared, "rt_ms", rt_breaks), na.rm = TRUE))
)

precision_limits_for <- function(data) {
  key <- attr(data, "subset_key")
  if (is.null(key) || !key %in% names(precision_ylim_map)) {
    key <- "sub1"
  }
  list(x = precision_xlim, y = precision_ylim_map[[key]])
}

rt_limits_for <- function(data) {
  key <- attr(data, "subset_key")
  if (is.null(key) || !key %in% names(rt_ylim_map)) {
    key <- "sub1"
  }
  list(x = rt_xlim, y = rt_ylim_map[[key]])
}
```

```{r plotting-utils, include=FALSE}
plot_precision_dist <- function(data, sub_label, pid, axial = FALSE) {
  participant_data <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(participant_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  circ_row <- circ_stats_safe(participant_data$theta_rad, axial = axial)
  circ_sd <- circ_row$std_circ_deg[[1]]
  abs_mean <- mean(participant_data$abs_precision_deg, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (length(circ_sd) == 0 || is.na(circ_sd)) circ_sd <- NA_real_
  if (length(abs_mean) == 0 || is.na(abs_mean)) abs_mean <- NA_real_

  limits <- precision_limits_for(data)
  ggplot(participant_data, aes(x = abs_precision_deg)) +
    geom_histogram(breaks = precision_breaks, fill = "steelblue3", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = paste(sub_label, "-", pid),
      subtitle = sprintf("circSD = %.2f deg | Abs Mean = %.2f deg", circ_sd, abs_mean),
      x = "Absolute precision (deg)",
      y = "Trial count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = limits$x, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = limits$y, expand = c(0, 0))
}

plot_RT_dist <- function(data, sub_label, pid) {
  participant_data <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(participant_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  mean_rt <- mean(participant_data$rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE)
  median_rt <- median(participant_data$rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE)

  limits <- rt_limits_for(data)
  ggplot(participant_data, aes(x = rt_ms)) +
    geom_histogram(breaks = rt_breaks, fill = "tomato2", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = mean_rt, linetype = "dashed", color = "navy") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = median_rt, linetype = "dotted", color = "darkgreen") +
    labs(
      title = paste(sub_label, "-", pid),
      subtitle = sprintf("RT distribution (mean %.0f ms / median %.0f ms)",
                         ifelse(is.na(mean_rt), NA_real_, mean_rt),
                         ifelse(is.na(median_rt), NA_real_, median_rt)),
      x = "Response time (ms)",
      y = "Trial count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = limits$x, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = limits$y, expand = c(0, 0))
}

walk_participant_histograms <- function(data, base_label, axial) {
  participants <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  purrr::walk(participants, function(pid) {
    p_prec <- plot_precision_dist(data, paste(base_label, "Precision"), pid, axial = axial)
    if (!is.null(p_prec)) print(p_prec)
    p_rt <- plot_RT_dist(data, paste(base_label, "RT"), pid)
    if (!is.null(p_rt)) print(p_rt)
  })
}
```

```{r group-level-plot-utils, include=FALSE}
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
pj <- position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.6, jitter.width = 0.15, seed = 42)

# Consistent across subexperiments: R / NR match sub1; Baseline distinct (sub2, sub3)
cue_type_colors <- c(
  "R-cue" = "#E884A6",
  "NR-cue" = "#3D9B9B",
  "Baseline" = "#4CAF50"
)

add_cue_type_scales <- function(plot) {
  plot +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = cue_type_colors) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = cue_type_colors)
}

summarise_cirsd_by_condition <- function(data, include_set_size = FALSE, axial = FALSE) {
  group_vars <- c("duration_ms", "cue_type")
  if (include_set_size) group_vars <- c(group_vars, "num_items")

  # group_modify: explicit per-group theta vectors (avoids summarise + .data[[col]] quirks)
  data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(theta_axial_rad = 2 * theta_rad) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~ {
      theta_vec <- if (axial) .x$theta_axial_rad else .x$theta_rad
      circ <- circ_stats_safe(theta_vec, axial = FALSE)
      if (axial) {
        circ <- circ %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            std_circ = std_circ / 2,
            std_circ_deg = std_circ_deg / 2
          )
      }
      circ
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

plot_group_precision <- function(data, label, include_set_size = FALSE, axial = FALSE) {
  summary <- summarise_cirsd_by_condition(
    data,
    include_set_size = include_set_size,
    axial = axial
  )

  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(duration_ms), y = abs_precision_deg, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position = pj, alpha = 0.35, size = 0.9) +
    geom_point(
      data = summary,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      aes(x = factor(duration_ms), y = std_circ_deg, fill = "gray", color = cue_type, group = cue_type),
      shape = 23,
      size = 2.5,
      stroke = 1.1,
      position = pd
    ) +
    labs(title = paste(label, "precision (abs error)"),
         subtitle = if (axial) "Axial CirSD (deg) per condition" else "CirSD (deg) per condition",
         x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Absolute precision (deg)") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0(x, " ms")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  plot <- add_cue_type_scales(plot)

  if (include_set_size) {
    plot <- plot + facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = ggplot2::label_both)
  }

  plot
}

plot_group_rt <- function(data, label, include_set_size = FALSE) {
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(duration_ms), y = rt_ms, fill = cue_type, color = cue_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, position = pd, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(position = pj, alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    labs(title = paste(label, "RT distribution"),
         subtitle = "Conditioned RT spread with quartiles from boxplots",
         x = "Encoding duration (ms)", y = "Response time (ms)") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) paste0(x, " ms")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  plot <- add_cue_type_scales(plot)

  if (include_set_size) {
    plot <- plot + facet_wrap(~ num_items, labeller = ggplot2::label_both)
  }

  plot
}

plot_participant_condition_precision <- function(data, label, pid, include_set_size = FALSE, axial = FALSE) {
  d <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  plot_group_precision(d, paste0(label, " — ", pid), include_set_size = include_set_size, axial = axial)
}

plot_participant_condition_rt <- function(data, label, pid, include_set_size = FALSE) {
  d <- data %>% filter(participant_id == pid)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(NULL)
  plot_group_rt(d, paste0(label, " — ", pid), include_set_size = include_set_size)
}

walk_participant_condition_plots <- function(data, label, include_set_size, axial) {
  pids <- sort(unique(data$participant_id))
  purrr::walk(pids, function(pid) {
    p_prec <- plot_participant_condition_precision(data, label, pid, include_set_size, axial)
    if (!is.null(p_prec)) print(p_prec)
    p_rt <- plot_participant_condition_rt(data, label, pid, include_set_size)
    if (!is.null(p_rt)) print(p_rt)
  })
}
```
